implementation.summary: D28 adds candidate-bound real local HTTP/SQLite evidence for model evaluation-gated promotion, digest-pinned deployment, health and telemetry, numeric drift policy/reporting, rollback and restart recovery. The journey uses the existing local.sklearn provider, SQLite registry/lab stores and LocalArtifactStore without mocks.

security_and_recovery.promotion_gate: A real registered model cannot be promoted before a passed evaluation; the journey records HTTP 409, then stores a passed operator review and promotes the same artifact-pinned version to champion.
security_and_recovery.serving_identity: Deployment creation re-verifies the registered artifact bytes, pins the model version and digest, exposes ready health, serves predictions and persists bounded request telemetry without following a changed champion.
security_and_recovery.drift_and_rollback: A versioned numeric drift policy is stored and recovered; a changed current window returns drifted for x; malformed thresholds return HTTP 400; rollback changes deployment status/readiness but leaves the registry champion unchanged; prediction after rollback returns HTTP 400.
security_and_recovery.workspace_scope: The real local composition returns HTTP 403 for the deployment read from an unknown workspace; all exercised routes use the configured bearer token and workspace scope.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Only the real local.sklearn provider and local SQLite/ArtifactStore composition were exercised. PostgreSQL ML stores, S3-compatible artifacts, MLflow/interoperability, network serving and external provider certification were not run and are not claimed.
